channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

item.title: CVE-2026-76519 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-0322 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

item.title: CVE-2026-105133 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.
